app.name: Family Firewall
app.mission: Teaches protective behavior. Does not detect scams and never claims to prevent them.

roles.parentSub: Simple practice drills and one-tap Pause
roles.familySub: Support, monitor drills, and stay connected

welcome.title: Welcome to Family Firewall
welcome.subtitle: Choose your language and your role to get started.

elderHome.greeting: Namaste! You are safe at home.
elderHome.subtitle: Rehearse calmly. Remember: Real police or courts never arrest anyone over video call.
elderHome.practiceSub: Rehearse a simulated scam call safely
elderHome.pressureSub: Quick reassurance and safe next steps
elderHome.callPersonSub: Direct call to your trusted contact
elderHome.familyConnectSubtitle: Link your family member to receive Pause alerts

familyHome.title: Family Member Dashboard
familyHome.description: Stay connected with your elders. Receive real-time Pause alerts and review completed drill outcomes.
familyHome.notConnectedSub: Pair your phone to receive instant Pause alerts and see drill practice outcomes.
familyHome.noDrillsYet: No practice drills recorded yet. Your parent can practice anytime.
familyHome.noEvents: No alerts recorded yet. Family is safe.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust language, text size, and trusted contacts.
settings.contactsSubtitle: Add up to 3 contacts. Stored only on this device.
settings.noContacts: No trusted contacts added yet. Tap below to add one.
settings.unlinkDesc: Disconnect from your family and permanently remove all local contacts, drill records, and settings from this phone.
settings.unlinkButton: Unlink family and delete my data
settings.unlinkConfirmMessage: This will remove your family link on the server and completely erase all contacts and drill history from this phone. You will return to the Welcome screen.

pauseModal.title: Take a deep breath. You are safe.
pauseModal.ruleReminder: Golden Rule: Real police, CBI, or judges NEVER place anyone under 'digital arrest' or interrogate over video call.
pauseModal.step1: 1. Disconnect the call immediately. You do not owe anyone on phone an explanation.
pauseModal.step3: 3. Speak directly to your trusted family person before doing anything else.
pauseModal.step4: 4. Never transfer money, share OTPs, or buy gift cards.
pauseModal.alertSent: Alert recorded locally. Your family member is notified.

practiceModal.title: Practice Drill Simulation
practiceModal.fictionalNotice: Fictional Organization: Central Cyber Verification Bureau (Simulation Only)
practiceModal.body: This is a safe training scenario to help you practice hanging up on fake official calls. Real enforcement officers never conduct court trials or demand money on video.
practiceModal.startPrompt: Deterministic drill engine will launch here in the next stage.

pressureModal.title: Feeling Pressured?
pressureModal.reassurance: Scammers create artificial panic and urgency to stop you from thinking clearly.
pressureModal.rule1: No genuine government agency will demand an immediate secret money transfer.
pressureModal.rule2: It is always 100% legal to disconnect and verify independently.
pressureModal.action: Call your trusted family member now to double-check.

callModal.noContactMessage: Please add at least one trusted contact in Settings so you can call them with one tap.

preDrill.line1: This is a safe practice call to rehearse how to handle pressure.
preDrill.line2: A family member can watch and practice along with you.

incoming.declineMessage: Declining unknown video calls is the exact right protective move. Real officers never conduct investigations or make arrests over video calls.

debrief.title: Drill Debrief
debrief.safeMessage: You protected yourself and your family. Great job recognizing the warning signs.
debrief.almostMessage: Good effort. You paused or avoided the worst risks, but stay alert for identity and OTP requests.
debrief.tryAgainMessage: Take a deep breath. Scammers create high pressure on purpose. Practice makes us stronger.
debrief.nextTime: One thing to try next time
debrief.pathMapSub: Shows the path you took versus the branches you avoided.

tactics.authority: The caller pretended to be an official officer to make you obey without questioning.
tactics.urgency: The caller created artificial time pressure so you could not stop to think.
tactics.isolation: The caller demanded you stay alone and not speak to your family.
tactics.secrecy: The caller insisted on total secrecy to keep trusted people from warning you.
tactics.fear: The caller made scary threats of arrest or police action to panic you.
tactics.info_request: The caller asked for sensitive identity details like your Aadhaar number or OTP.
tactics.payment_request: The caller demanded money transfer to a supposed safe account.

feedback.wellHungUp: You disconnected the call promptly when things felt suspicious.
feedback.wellToldSomeone: You insisted on involving your family instead of staying isolated.
feedback.wellUsedPause: You took a protective pause to think clearly before reacting.
feedback.wellCalm: You stayed calm and observed the caller's tactics.
feedback.nextMoney: Never send money or transfer funds to any account during an unsolicited call. Real police never ask for money transfers.
feedback.nextInfo: Never share OTPs or personal identity details like Aadhaar over a call.
feedback.nextHangUp: You can hang up immediately and press Pause or contact your trusted family member.
feedback.nextKeepPracticing: Keep practicing! Hanging up early and consulting family is always the safest move.

consent.title: Before You Connect Family
consent.elderSubtitle: You stay in complete control. Your personal phone calls and safe word NEVER leave this phone.
consent.guardianSubtitle: Family Firewall connects you for safety alerts and practice outcomes only. Personal conversations are never shared.
consent.willSeePause: When you tap the orange Pause button
consent.willSeeDrill: Practice drill outcomes (Safe, Almost, Let's try again)
consent.willSeeTime: Date and time of safety alerts
consent.willNotSeeTitle: What your family will NEVER see:
consent.willNotSeeCalls: Phone calls or who you talk to
consent.willNotSeeContacts: Your safe word, contacts, or phone numbers

safeword.title: Family Secret Safe Word
safeword.explanation: The safe word is used to verify a caller who claims to be a relative, and should never be typed into the Pause screen.
safeword.deviceOnlyNotice: Stored only on this device — never sent to any server.
safeword.savedSuccess: Safe word saved securely on device!
safeword.inputTip: Agree together on a word or short phrase that only close family knows.

verifyCaller.title: Verify This Caller
verifyCaller.largeInstruction: Ask the caller for the family safe word. If they cannot say it, hang up and call your person.
verifyCaller.understood: I Will Ask For The Safe Word

pact.title: Printable Pact Card
pact.subtitle: Place this card beside your landline or mobile for immediate family protection.
pact.printSafeWordOption: Print the safe word on the card
pact.lostCardWarning: Warning: A lost or misplaced card reveals your safe word to anyone.
pact.cardSub: Keep near your phone. Pause and read before sending any money.
pact.rule1Desc: Never transfer money to a caller claiming to be police, court, or customs.
pact.rule2Desc: Real officials and banks will NEVER ask for your SMS OTP or PIN.
pact.rule3Title: Hang up and call a family member.
pact.rule3Desc: Disconnect suspicious calls immediately and reach your trusted contact.
pact.realOfficialsQuote: Real officials never ask for money on a video call

privacyProof.title: Privacy Proof
privacyProof.heading: Zero Cloud Leak Guarantee
privacyProof.subheading: Inspect every outbound network request and realtime message leaving this device in real time.
privacyProof.localDataTitle: Items Stored Only On This Phone
privacyProof.leavesPair: Family link pairing codes & membership cluster ID
privacyProof.leavesPause: Safety Pause alert signal (timestamp & trigger source)
privacyProof.leavesOutcome: Practice drill outcome summary (Safe / Almost / Let's try again, refusal checks)
privacyProof.neverPhone: Phone numbers and trusted contact names
privacyProof.neverAudio: Microphone audio, voice recordings, or call sounds
privacyProof.neverDetailed: Detailed drill pressure tactics, notes, and local event logs
privacyProof.appCodeNotice: Note: This log displays outbound requests and events initiated by the application code.
privacyProof.noRequestsYet: No outbound requests recorded in this session yet.
